name: User
description: Store user information for customers, agents, and administrators with role-based access

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the user

fields.name: email
fields.description: User's email address for login and communication

fields.name: fullName
fields.description: User's full name

fields.name: role
fields.description: User role: customer, agent, or administrator

fields.name: passwordHash
fields.description: Hashed password for authentication

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Whether the user account is active

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the user account was created

constraints.role: Must be one of: customer, agent, administrator

name: TicketCategory
description: Define and organize ticket types for proper routing and classification in the support ticket management system

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the ticket category

fields.name: name
fields.description: Display name of the category (e.g., Technical Support, Billing, Bug Report)

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed description of what tickets belong in this category

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates whether this category is currently available for new tickets

fields.name: priority
fields.description: Display order priority for category listing (lower numbers appear first)

fields.name: defaultAssigneeId
fields.description: Default user or team ID to route tickets in this category

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the category was created

relationships.description: Links to the default assignee for tickets in this category

name: Ticket
description: Central data model capturing ticket details from submission through resolution with complete lifecycle tracking

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the ticket

fields.name: title
fields.description: Brief summary of the ticket issue or request

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed description of the ticket issue or request

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status of the ticket (e.g., open, in_progress, resolved, closed)

fields.name: priority
fields.description: Priority level of the ticket (e.g., low, medium, high, urgent)

fields.name: categoryId
fields.description: Reference to the ticket category

fields.name: submittedBy
fields.description: User ID of the person who submitted the ticket

fields.name: assignedTo
fields.description: User ID of the support agent assigned to handle the ticket

relationships.description: Each ticket belongs to one category
Each ticket is submitted by one user
Each ticket can be assigned to one support agent

indexes.description: Index on status for filtering tickets by current state
Index on submittedBy for retrieving user's tickets
Index on assignedTo for retrieving assigned tickets

name: Comment
description: Stores all comments, responses, and internal notes associated with tickets, supporting both public customer-facing communications and private internal agent notes

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the comment

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the ticket this comment belongs to

fields.name: authorId
fields.description: Reference to the user who created the comment

fields.name: content
fields.description: The actual text content of the comment or note

fields.name: isInternal
fields.description: Flag indicating if this is a private internal note (true) or public customer-facing comment (false)

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the comment was created

relationships.description: Each comment belongs to one ticket
Each comment is authored by one user

indexes.description: Optimize retrieval of comments for a ticket in chronological order
Optimize queries for comments by a specific author

name: Attachment
description: Manages file uploads associated with tickets and comments in the support system

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the attachment

fields.name: fileName
fields.description: Original name of the uploaded file

fields.name: fileUrl
fields.description: Storage path or URL reference to the uploaded file

fields.name: fileType
fields.description: MIME type of the file (e.g., image/png, application/pdf)

fields.name: fileSize
fields.description: Size of the file in bytes

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the ticket this attachment belongs to

fields.name: commentId
fields.description: Reference to the comment this attachment belongs to (null if attached directly to ticket)

fields.name: uploadedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the file was uploaded

relationships.description: Each attachment belongs to one ticket
Each attachment may belong to one comment
